messages.subject: CFA ERROR: data object of class list
parts:
Hello, I'm hoping someone will be able to help with the following error I'm getting. I've used this syntax before but cannot get it to work for this dataset.

> LeadCFA.Model='Business=~DMCore1+DMLead1+InnCore1+InnLead1+DRCore1+DRLead1
+ People=~TCore+TLead+MotCore+MotLead+CollCore+CollLead'
> fit<-cfa(model=LeadCFA.Model, data=leaddata)
Error in lavData(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: data object of class list

I made sure the latent variables in the model are not already existing variables in the dataset. Any ideas?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: CFA ERROR: data object of class list
parts:
The output of: 

class(leaddata) 

yields:

[1] "list"

Is there a separate command to make my dataset a data.frame?

A data.frame actually is a special case of a list object, where each list element is (a) an atomic vector and (b) has the same length.  So if leaddata is a list of vectors of the same length, 
sapply(leaddata, is.atomic)
sapply(leaddata, length)
all(sapply(leaddata, is.atomic)) # should be TRUE
all(sapply(leaddata, length) == sapply(leaddata, length)[1]) # should be TRUE
then you can make it a data.frame like this:

leadDF <- as.data.frame(leaddata)

Terry
